summary: No blocker to the stated actual initialization/gradient/save-restore engineering claims. Both real runs completed exit 0 with identical recorded collated inputs. WARN preserves remote-payload, same-process and non-accuracy limits.

A_ground_truth_provenance.details: Real Joint3DDataset training batches supply center_label, size_gts, gt_masks and language maps after model.forward. Prediction-only mask references are model geometry, not GT. Native corresponding_loss terms also use predicted query masks as auxiliary consistency targets; they are training losses, not reported accuracy. Raw dataset contents and original batch tensors were not independently reloaded by this reviewer.

B_score_normalization.details: Neither preflight computes formal performance. Raw per-step losses agree with cumulative loss averages in native logs. saved_retained_metrics and formal_accuracy are null. The normal evaluator source uses dataset GT hit counts, not normalization by the maximum of model predictions; the normal entry requires both denominators 9508. This evaluator was not executed in these preflights.

C_result_existence.details: All 38 manifest input digests match. Each arm has nine directly checked intake file bindings, an exit-0 status/log, receipt, matching training diagnostic and initial comparison. Remote checkpoint inventory hashes and lengths equal their receipts, but model bytes were not independently downloaded or locally loaded. Original protocol timestamps/runtime-false fields are source-preparation snapshots; actual controller status and intake establish completion.

D_dead_code_and_actual_calls.details: The helper calls native train_one_epoch; its observation wrapper calls and returns the original criterion loss. The native method performs forward, GT attachment, backward, clipping, AdamW and scheduler steps, supported by logs and changed parameters. No evaluate_one_epoch call occurs in the helper. The dormant DIoU function has only commented call sites in the inspected loss; it has no attributed result. Future evaluator source presence is not credited as an executed result.

E_scope.details: Two configurations at seed 2027, same two B8 collated inputs, 16 row presentations and two optimizer updates per arm. Constructed train/validation lengths are 36665/9508; 9508 is not a completed evaluation. Unique scenes and unique annotation count are not established by stored hashes alone. Evidence supports initialization, gradient reachability, parameter changes and same-process save/restore. It does not establish accuracy, new best, module efficacy, complete training, complete source removal, cold-process or next-batch continuity.

F_evaluation_type.details: Classification: real_gt supervised training engineering preflight, with native auxiliary prediction-consistency losses. Formal accuracy evaluation was not executed. No model-generated reference is presented as benchmark accuracy.

engineering_checks.details: Both actual input_batch_sha256 lists are equal. Original protocols differ only in native_init_spec and face_residual_mode; initializer specs differ only in face_residual_mode. Admitted protocol copies change only status and serial_gpu_preflight_admitted. Equality covers recorded collated inputs, not bitwise cross-process trajectories.

Strict official/G/support/span initialization precedes Face wrapping. The executed helper asserts that the 1295 retained E0 states match exactly after explicit axis-prior prefix remapping; six new Face state entries yield 1301. Face adds 23425 parameters and complete span has 53218. Both admissions record retained E0 SHA ed8455ddc67e4d17018e9cf499197140e15e35db3f5daee55e0eec6846faf0c4. That ancestor had C enabled; this C-off configuration is not never-C-trained.

Each arm records bitwise initial center/size equality against its own retained axis formula, zero Face movement, zero differing size elements, 46 sizes below 1e-6 and minimum 9.99999883788405e-7. Both native/reference inputs are floored at 1e-6 and gates are bounded. The minimum is exactly one binary32 ULP below binary32(1e-6)=9.999999974752427e-7, supporting float32 convex-mix rounding. This does not compare full output tensors between processes or independently run a baseline forward.

Native Text-mask matching uses class/bbox/GIoU/mask costs 1/0/2/0.0002. Native query-mask and corresponding/fused-mask losses remain. G correction is enabled and records 193 then 293 reassigned queries. Only C extra selected-query-mask supervision is off; helper asserts the C extra-loss keys are absent.

Both Face output steps have positive pre-clipping gradient norms. With the zero output layer, first-step Face internal gradient is zero; second-step internal gradient is positive and both Face groups change parameters. Core/backbone/support have positive gradients each step and retained span groups also have gradients and changes. The combined original_core_and_G_reader gradient is not isolated G causal evidence.

Both saves contain 1301 model states and 826 Adam states, all Adam steps equal 2. Rebuilt model/optimizer/scheduler are compared for exact model values, optimizer keys/groups/values, scheduler and Python/NumPy/Torch/CUDA global RNG. This occurs within one process; engineering epoch 0 restores start_epoch 1. DataLoader generator/worker/sampler progress, next batch and cold-process trajectory recovery are not tested.

All 118 staging hash entries equal SOURCE_HASHES and both protocol catalogs; paths match the isolated PV root. Six locally read original source bodies match those pins. Nine recorded PV module origins map into the catalog; pcdet.config is recorded under the established external runtime. The controller rehashes every source before execution and the observer rehashes them after closure. This review does not freshly inspect all remote source bodies or the external runtime payload.

without_additional_source zeros only added Face residual tokens and source_fraction. The retained source-aware axis prior, prior gates, geometry, query and parameter capacity are common. This is control of additional direct Face source evidence, not a source-free model or complete source ablation.

The existing normal launcher requires this exact ACTUAL_NATIVE_FACE_PREFLIGHT_PAIR audit, bound intakes/receipts and its SOURCE_ONLY review. Its normal child forbids checkpoint_path and loads fresh native initializer weights, not M0 model/Adam. This audit satisfies only the engineering-audit prerequisite; live source/environment/ancestor/process/GPU/disk gates and a separate launch action remain necessary.

non_blocking_findings.finding: Engineering checkpoint bytes are receipt-bound remote artifacts, not independent local payload audits. Each is 841963854 bytes and unscored. Cleanup is not verified or performed.
Same-process object reconstruction and global state equality only; not cold-process, DataLoader/worker state restoration, next-batch or continuous replay.
No formal 9508 accuracy, new best, three effective modules, normal three-epoch completion or Nr3D/Sr3D result.

Pre-clipping group gradients and parameter changes do not isolate every G parameter or establish efficacy.
